author: codex-cli-gpt-5.6-luna-medium
objective: Implement a deterministic Rich-backed log triage reporter with strict JSONL validation, stable aggregation and ordering, literal message rendering, and an executable reproduction harness.
acceptance: Valid structured JSONL produces the exact deterministic report and stable tie ordering
Malformed records, duplicate IDs, unsupported levels, invalid timestamps, control characters, and wrong field types fail closed
Messages containing Rich-looking markup remain literal and output is noninteractive and ANSI-free
The reproduction harness exercises the implementation and all declared deliverables execute successfully
skills: stable aggregation and deterministic text output

source.scenario: An authored offline incident-review workflow receives JSONL application events and needs a reproducible human-readable triage report.
